headline: Read your Efergy monitor
intro: Connect an Efergy monitor with its API key, then bring power, energy, and cost readings from the cloud into Home Assistant sensors.
highlights: The setup form checks the API key against Efergy and identifies the monitor by its hub ID.
Sensor readings include instantaneous power and energy and cost totals for day, week, month, and year; month totals are enabled by default.
Current power readings are created for each sensor ID, with per-sensor entities enabled by default when the monitor has multiple sensors.

flow.title: From API key to readings
stages: Home Assistant checks the connection and hub ID
Load power, energy, and cost sensors
